findings.rationale: Valid: the range diff contradicted the store-commit exemption. Base tree is now the remote sha / merge-base only when it already has repo.toml, else the store-introducing commit, so the store commit's notices are outside the diff; positive acceptance case: cutover branch and post-cutover develop push against pre-cutover origin/develop pass without --no-verify.
Same fix as 22d6c331f1; the A3.4 acceptance case for the store commit can now be green.

Valid: post-merge/post-rewrite no longer exec; they run hippo hook <name> and keep its result: exit 3 is printed and left to hippo-problems (spec 11.5, no lockout); the marker is written only when hippo is missing or could not check, and is cleared once a check runs (exit 0 or 3). Verified hippo P1.2 guard.rs ships all four hook names; acceptance adds the fast-forward and hidden-hippo cases.
Valid: files-mode decision new --ledger-row <id> is now a no-op (the row is the decision); acceptance asserts one ledger row after the append plus dev-flow's call.
Folded: file map row and A3.1 step 5 now put inventory rows in the mechanism commit, matching C8.
